editorial.blurb: An authentic French bakery gem tucked into Hyde Park that transports you to Paris with impeccable croissants, fresh pastries, and expertly crafted coffee.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask about the Swiss chocolate croissant and breakfast croissant with egg, swiss cheese, avocado, ham and bacon — both are standouts that reviewers call must-haves. The cafe has quiet indoor and outdoor seating perfect for lingering.
